summary: Closed the exact group-128 AWQ W4 decode-MLP intervention. Real-weight outputs were correct, but the admitted M32 chain was 8.51% slower than current FP8 and produced a -1.014% whole-request bound. Causal counters show that 48.05% fewer stored weight bytes did not compensate for the Marlin kernels' 200 registers/thread, 233472 shared-memory bytes/block, and one-wave-per-SM geometry.
next_action: No replay and no sweep. The preregistered 3% component gate failed, so coherence and the c32 endpoint pair were correctly not invoked. The bench is released ready; choose a distinct mechanism if the campaign remains open.
compute_budget: One retained H200, at most 120 claimed GPU-minutes.
wall_clock_budget: At most 2.4 hours from first researcher start and no work beyond the bench watchdog deadline.
storage_budget: At most 25 GiB staged and retrieved project data.
